title: wire util::domains into MGnify recall and into pid
body: util::domains ports classify_direct, the classifier behind the May 2026 MGnify multi-domain analysis. MGnify recall and pid are its two intended consumers and neither is wired to it. For MGnify, h_cut is nail's cutoff (nail_3 in data/mgy-cutoffs.tbl) held against hmmer's scores, for now: that table has no hmmer column, and the cutoffs.txt the May analysis read is gone. In pid, 9 of the 12 decoys inside hmmer.prf's 1% threshold score through several domains, and 126 of the top 500 do.
